name: smwpatches-cheep-cheep-water-surface-fix-stay-in-water
title: Cheep-Cheep Water Surface Fix + Stay In Water
description:
Cheep-Cheep will turn around just before it leaves the water.
It will not flutter on the surface of the water.
It can also be used in combination with Sine Wave.
It is not compatible with moving water in layer 2.

[Update]
Fixed a bug that would break Sprite 18. Thanks to Ayami for reporting this bug.
